mapper.sql: a.article_id, a.title, a.author, a.published_time, a.content, a.collection, a.share, a.comment, a.star, a.stick, a.page_view
mapper.select: SELECT , u.nickname as author_nick, u.portrait as author_img FROM a_article a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.author = u.user_id WHERE a.article_id = #{articleId} LIMIT 1
SELECT , u.nickname as author_nick, u.portrait as author_img FROM a_article a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.author = u.user_id ORDER BY a.stick DESC, a.published_time DESC
SELECT , u.nickname as author_nick, u.portrait as author_img FROM a_article a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.author = u.user_id ORDER BY a.stick DESC, a.published_time DESC
SELECT , u.nickname as author_nick, u.portrait as author_img FROM a_article a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.author = u.user_id WHERE a.author = #{userId} ORDER BY a.published_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO a_article (title, author, content, collection, share, comment, star, stick, page_view) VALUES (#{title}, #{authorId}, #{content}, #{collection}, #{share}, #{comment}, #{star}, #{stick}, #{pageView})
mapper.update: UPDATE a_article SET page_view = page_view + 1 WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
UPDATE a_article SET star = star + 1 WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
UPDATE a_article SET star = GREATEST(star - 1, 0) WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
UPDATE a_article SET comment = comment + 1 WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
UPDATE a_article SET comment = GREATEST(comment - 1, 0) WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
UPDATE a_article SET collection = collection + 1 WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
UPDATE a_article SET collection = GREATEST(collection - 1, 0) WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
UPDATE a_article SET share = share + 1 WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
